ROBINSONS MALOLOS

  • Introduction

  • Mall Directory
    • |

    • |
  • Lingkod Pinoy

Robinsons Malolos, the 35th mall in Robinsons Malls' nationwide chain and its second in Bulacan, is part of the plan to put up more shopping centers in key cities north of Metro Manila. Robinsons Malolos is a four-storey development with a multi-level parking area. It has a floor area of 67,340 square meters with more than 550 parking slots. It is built on a 2.6 hectare lot along MacArthur Highway, within close proximity to all the commercial, educational and government institutions, as well as hospitals, churches, and residential developments. Robinsons Place Malolos counts as its anchor stores Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Department Store, Handyman, Robinsons Appliance, South Star Drug and Robinsons Bank. Robinsons Movieworld has four all-digital cinemas including a 3D cinema. The mall offers a wide selection of restaurants and fastfood outlets, fashion boutiques, tech and service stores as well as health and beauty clinics. It also has a food court that showcases the best of Bulacans food and culinary treasures as well as sampling of specialties from other provinces. There are currently 46 operational stores and 57 others are opening soon. The mall also features a Lingkod Pinoy Center, a one-stop facility for various government services. Lingkod Pinoy houses Pag-IBIG, Philhealth, Phlpost, SSS and TESDA.

All ages are allowed inside the mall.

Shop for your favorites and stock up on your essentials daily at Robinsons Malolos.
